intervals.label: first beams and commissioning
intervals.note: LNF says first beams circulated in 1997; INFN's laboratories page says DAFNE "started operating" in 1999 (taken as the end of commissioning).
intervals.quote: The first particle beams started circulating in DAΦNE in 1997.

intervals.label: e+e- collider operation (phi factory)
intervals.note: INFN (2026) says SIDDHARTA2 is "now operating at DAFNE", so the collider is still in use. KLOE took data from 1999 (CERN Courier) or 2000 (LNF) to 2006; KLOE-2 from November 2014 to 30 March 2018; SIDDHARTA-2 and PADME since.

intervals.label: KLOE-2 run with crab-waist collisions
intervals.note: First application of the crab-waist collision scheme in the presence of a high-field detector solenoid; KLOE-2 data taking ended on 30 March 2018. LNF notes the crab-waist scheme was first tested at DAΦNE in 2007.
intervals.quote: The implementation of this innovative configuration by the DAΦNE team allowed KLOE-2 to collect an integrated luminosity of 5.5 fb−1 in a period of just over three years.

name: DAΦNE
notes: KLOE start: CERN Courier says KLOE first collected data in 1999; the LNF particle-physics page says it took data from 2000 to 2006.

circumference.note: Each ring is about 100 m in length; recorded as the approximate ring circumference.
circumference.quote: The accelerator consists of 2 rings approx. 100 m in length

cms_energy.note: Tuned to the mass of the phi meson.
cms_energy.quote: The total energy of the beams in the reference system of the centre of the mass is equal to 1.02 GeV

peak_luminosity.note: Record for an e+e- collider at these energies (about 1 GeV), reached during the KLOE-2 run.
peak_luminosity.quote: Record performances in terms of peak luminosity (2.4 × 1032 cm–2 s–1)

summary.plain: An electron-positron collider at Italy's Frascati laboratory, tuned to 1.02 GeV so that collisions make phi mesons in large numbers (a phi factory). It hosted the KLOE and KLOE-2 experiments until 2018 and now runs SIDDHARTA-2, with first beams in 1997.
summary.technical: DAΦNE: two ~100 m e⁺e⁻ rings with two interaction points, √s = 1.02 GeV (φ resonance); first beams 1997, operating from 1999; peak luminosity 2.4×10³² cm⁻² s⁻¹ with the crab-waist scheme; experiments KLOE (1999-2006), FINUDA, DEAR, SIDDHARTA, KLOE-2 (2014-2018), SIDDHARTA-2; also the BTF and DAΦNE-Light.
